links.comparator_used: Expert radiologist ratings of the same summaries (consistency measured with Kendall's coefficient of concordance); LLM-judge prompt variants compared by scale size and scale description detail
links.outcome: Consistency of LLM-as-a-Judge ratings with radiologist expert ratings of LLM-generated clinical summaries
links.effect: No numeric values in the abstract. No definitive association between scale size and consistency. For most criteria, consistency was highest when the judges had a detailed description of extreme scale values or no detailed scale description.
links.tradeoff: Criteria that work for human evaluation were not always suitable for an LLM judge. Development needed choices about rating scale, criteria and prompt granularity, and a diverse expert team.
links.quote: No definitive association was identified between scale size and the consistency of ratings between radiologist experts and LLMs-as-a-Judges.

design_hint: LLM-as-a-judge prompt configuration (scale size, criteria, prompt granularity) for evaluating summaries
